name: mirage
text: Version 1.0.76 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.76 . After each report is saved to GitHub, the phone clears its logs, so the file stays small. Install it and leave the +EV tab running for about 20 minutes. The first report lands about a minute after the app starts, then every 20 minutes. I'll read it from GitHub and tell you what the logs show for the vanishing bets and for 'no one was selling'.
